description: Unit tests for provider environment variable utilities, including functions to list known provider and secret env vars, omit env keys case-insensitively, and retrieve provider env vars based on provider name, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for provider environment variables.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates assertions to verify code behavior.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: listKnownProviderAuthEnvVarNames
methods.description: Returns a list of known provider authentication environment variable names.

methods.name: listKnownSecretEnvVarNames
methods.description: Returns a list of known secret environment variable names.

methods.name: omitEnvKeysCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Removes specified environment variables from an object case-insensitively.

methods.name: getProviderEnvVars
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables related to a specific provider.
